additive : Prop and compatibleWithPerfectComplexes : Prop are arbitrary fields, each paired with a proof of that supplied proposition. Neither field is a formula about ch, addition or perfect complexes.

Both theorem declarations contain actual proof terms under explicit M/H/ch hypotheses: chern_realization_additive returns ch.additive via ch.additive_certified, and chern_realization_compatible returns ch.compatibleWithPerfectComplexes via its supplied witness. These proofs are preserved and not dismissed as nonexistent.

The captured CohomologyClass source was fully read: it stores a degree-indexed family H.Class, a degree and a value with no cohomology operations/axioms. Its ClassEquality.equal is a genuine degree equality, while compatible is separately arbitrary; the source explicitly says crystalline cohomology is not constructed.

Captured KTheoryIndex/KTheoryClass/MellKTheory contexts were previously fully read and their exact pins reverified. They store class values and arbitrary semantic contracts without constructing K-theory groups or an index correspondence.

There is no actual Chern character construction, additive equation, homomorphism law, degree compatibility equation, perfect-complex relation, crystalline cohomology or comparison theorem in this source. The name and documentation do not supply absent formulas.
